title: Installation Allowance on Food-Loss Payments for Refrigerators and Freezers Northgate Installed
content:
An installation allowance is added to a Northgate Protect Standard-tier food-loss payment for a refrigerator or freezer Northgate installed: the replacement-install allowance of $20.00 when the covered order is a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order on which a haul-away fee was charged for the old unit, the delivered-install allowance of $10.00 when it is such an order with no haul-away fee, and nothing for an item the customer took home or had shipped.

The fulfilment program and the haul-away fee are read from the covered order in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records.

| Covered order | Haul-away fee charged on it | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | Yes | $20.00 |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | No | $10.00 |
| Any other fulfilment program | Not relevant | Nothing |

## Points of judgement

- A haul-away fee counts only where one was charged on the covered order; a fee recorded at zero is not a charge.
- *Hypothetical:* a chest freezer delivered by Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery with the old freezer hauled away for a fee adds $20.00; the same freezer collected through Northgate Order Pickup adds nothing.
